title: Monoculture Robust Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a notion of monoculture robustness in Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning, as a way to mitigate the problem of algorithmic monoculture (Kleinberg and Raghavan, 2021): the tendency of models sharing the same components (e.g., training data) to fail on the same inputs. Specifically, we ask whether a learner with access to a single dataset can output $k$ individually accurate hypotheses whose joint failure probability is comparable to training on $k$ independent datasets. We say that such a learning procedure achieves monoculture robustness, and we quantify this by bounding the conjunctive error that all $k$ hypotheses misclassify points in an individual sense. We design methods for achieving this type of guarantee by drawing a surprising connection between replicability (Impagliazzo et al., 2022) and monoculture robustness. translated_abstract: 我们在概率近似正确（PAC）学习中引入了“单一文化鲁棒性”的概念，以此作为缓解算法单一文化问题（Kleinberg和Raghavan，2021）的一种途径：即共享相同组件（如训练数据）的模型往往在相同的输入上失败。具体而言，我们探讨了一个仅访问单一数据集的学习器能否输出 $k$ 个各自准确的假设，且这些假设的联合失败概率可与在 $k$ 个独立数据集上训练相媲美。我们将这样的学习过程称为实现了单一文化鲁棒性，并通过约束联合误差来量化这一性质，即在个体意义上所有 $k$ 个假设都错误分类某点的概率。我们通过揭示可复现性（Impagliazzo等人，2022）与单一文化鲁棒性之间出人意料的联系，设计了实现这类保证的方法。具体来说，我们证明了如果基础学习器是 $\rho$-可复现的，那么独立运行它……
tldr: 该论文在PAC学习中提出了“单一文化鲁棒性”概念，并揭示了可复现性与单一文化鲁棒性之间的惊人联系，使仅拥有单一数据集的学习器能输出 $k$ 个联合失败概率可与 $k$ 个独立数据集训练相媲美的准确假设，从而缓解算法单一文化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the notion of monoculture robustness in PAC learning and reveals a surprising connection between replicability and monoculture robustness, enabling a learner with access to a single dataset to output $k$ individually accurate hypotheses whose joint failure probability is comparable to training on $k$ independent datasets, thereby mitigating the problem of algorithmic monoculture.
